title: Her first teacher Anna Stewart and conservatory-trained teachers
summary: Her first teacher was Anna Stewart, a Boston Conservatory graduate now retired. The interviewer adds that Dr. Nelson's wife was also a Boston-trained pianist and teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: And what is her name again now? Mrs. Stewart. What was her first name? Anna. Anna Stewart. And she's still living in New Orleans.
Yes, she's still living in New Orleans. Although she has retired. But she was a graduate of the Boston Conservatory. And she was wonderful.

I believe since I mentioned Louie Nelson, you know, there was a doctor, Nelson, who just died last summer, I guess. And his wife, who's been dead a long time, I never met her, also is a graduate in piano at Boston. She was. Music school in Boston, either New England or Boston Conservatory, I forget what. I was going to mention some of the musicians, even trumpet players and clarinetists, tell me that when they'd want to take up the instrument, their teacher, even people like Manuel Perez, before they'd teach it. . . .
